title: Excelent relaxing trip
text: Very detailed with communicating meeting spot.  Accommodating and made us feel comfortable.  I would go again.
author: gladd4jc

title: Book this one!
text: Jorge was great! Made sure we had directions, meeting spot with pictures and maps. Outstanding customer service! Sailing experience itself was great as well. Strong winds that day but safe and great boat! We didnt motor out watch a sunset then sail in, we sailed the whole time once clear of the marina! Jorge is a very knowledgeable seaman with his boat as an extension of his body! I highly recommend a sailing experience with him!
author: eriknE7402LW

title: Best boat experience in Barcelona!!
text: AMAZING EXPERIENCE!! Jorge is the best sailor you could ask for. He made sure we were having a good time and experience. No limits on snacks and drinks. Super approachable and a perfect attitude. I recommend this experience 100%.
author: catooro

title: Amazing sunset cruise!
text: We had a great time on the boat! Jorge was amazing and a great host! We recommend his tours 👏👏🌟Thank you!
